prior_claim: ordinary typed category is the weakest common process structure with six retained components

successors.statement: Typed interfaces, admitted nontrivial process steps, and finite typed path formation suffice for the registered sequential-history requirements.
For the path presentation, empty-history units and associativity follow from finite-list path construction.
Category and typed-path presentations can realize the same registered reachability semantics; no unique weakest syntax is claimed.
